categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Jet Bio-Filtration Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of life science consumables, focusing on two main product categories: biological culture consumables and liquid handling consumables. The company also offers a limited range of biological reagents, small laboratory instruments, protective equipment, and medical devices, serving over a thousand product types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced polymer material modification technologies, including plasma treatment for hydrophilic, superhydrophilic, and superhydrophobic surface modifications, temperature-sensitive polymer modifications, and 3D printing material modification. Manufacturing processes include high-precision injection molding, high-speed extrusion, automated assembly, and intelligent manufacturing upgrades to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include biological laboratories in universities, research institutions in life sciences and medicine, disease control centers, inspection and quarantine agencies, hospitals, pharmaceutical and vaccine companies, and biotechnology firms. The products are applied in fields such as biomedicine, molecular diagnostics, medical protection, cell therapy, and biological research.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide sales network covering core regions through 12 offices and numerous distributors. Internationally, it exports to over 30 countries including the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Australia, India, Brazil, and Argentina, with subsidiaries established in the U.S. and plans for European market expansion centered in Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jet Bio-Filtration operates mainly in the midstream segment of the life science consumables supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and direct sales of consumable products. It procures raw polymer materials primarily from imports and some domestic sources, outsources sterilization processes, and sells products to end-users and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in polymer material surface modification, cell culture consumables, and liquid handling products, with active development in cell therapy, biomedicine, infectious disease detection, and vaccine research. It emphasizes intelligent manufacturing upgrades, automation, and expanding product lines including medical consumables and devices. The firm also focuses on breaking foreign technology monopolies and increasing domestic market share through import substitution and export growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of life science consumables, including self-developed and ODM products. Sales channels include direct sales and authorized exclusive distributors domestically, and ODM and distributor models internationally. The company also sells some biological reagents and small instruments via OEM arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global market is dominated by multinational giants like VWR, Corning, Thermo Fisher, and Merck KGaA. Domestically, Jet Bio-Filtration is one of the earliest and leading life science consumable manufacturers with advanced technology and product quality close to international standards. It holds a growing market share in China but still faces strong competition from established foreign brands and increasing domestic players amid industry overcapacity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 463 million, a 24% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 34.8 million, down 60%. Total assets reached RMB 1.63 billion with a slight growth of 1.3%. Despite short-term declines due to market conditions and increased costs, the company maintains a solid financial position with a 28.8% asset-liability ratio and continues investing about 6% of revenue in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jet Bio-Filtration emphasizes providing reliable, high-quality, and technologically advanced life science consumables with superior polymer material modifications and precision manufacturing. Its products offer competitive pricing due to domestic production cost advantages while matching international product performance. The company also focuses on comprehensive solutions, strong customer service, and expanding intelligent manufacturing capabilities to enhance product consistency and customer satisfaction.
